snippet.title: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vampire Crawlers is out now on Xbox Series X|S. Deal world-ending combos and blitz through infested dungeons!

Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors is a casual, turn-based deckbuilder with rouguelite elements. Master the TURBOTURN with your own hands of cards. 

Vampire Crawlers is out now on Xbox Series XIS, Xbox on PC and Xbox Cloud. It’s also available Day 1 with Xbox Game Pass Ultimate.
